title: 25 € a Month at 16 vs 100 € at 40: Who Wins? 💶 #shorts
description:
Guess before the end: who's richer at 67? Comment 1 or 2.

Person 1 invests 25 € a month from 16 to 67 (paid in 15,300 €), person 2 invests 100 € a month from 40 to 67 (paid in 32,400 €). At an assumed ~6 % a year (monthly payments and compounding, before tax and costs) person 1 could end with about 101,000 € and person 2 with about 81,000 €. The 6 % is a conservative assumption below the MSCI World's historical 7.7 % average over 15-year periods (1975-2017, Finanztip). Returns are not guaranteed; values go up and down, and the past is no promise.

Sources: Finanztip (MSCI World return analysis); maths: monthly compounding

Not financial advice.
